desc:
🚙 Welcome to Monster Truck to Steal Eggs! 🥚

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from different animals
🚙 Drive your Monster Truck and escape
⚡ Upgrade your truck to go faster
🗺️ Unlock new areas with stronger animals
🐉 Discover rare, Mythic, and Secret eggs
💰 Earn Cash from your eggs, even while offline
🔧 Upgrade your Speed and Monster Truck
✨ Collect bigger and rarer eggs

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet
